ep01.title: My First Day: A Little House by the Lake | Cozy Minecraft Longplay (No Commentary)
ep01.summary: A fresh survival world in an oak and birch forest by a lake: chopping trees, a first night and a rough shelter. By the end a small plank house with windows stands in the meadow, with a tiny wheat patch by the water.

ep02.title: A Farm by the Lake, a Red Sunset and Morning Rain | Cozy Minecraft Longplay (No Commentary)
ep02.summary: Night mining under the starter house, then the cottage grows a stone roof and a lakeside wheat farm. Sheep join the farm, a deep red sunset falls, rain rolls in and the episode ends on a bright sunrise over the lake.

ep03.title: Rainy Days and a Long Cave Dive Under My Cottage | Cozy Minecraft Longplay (No Commentary)
ep03.summary: A morning at the lakeside cottage with its wheat farm and cozy kitchen, then a long descent into a dark cave system for ores. Rainy evenings and a red stormy sunset on the surface, more night caving, and a sunny look at the cottage to close.

ep04.title: Building a Stone-Roof Cottage After a Lush Cave | Cozy Minecraft Longplay (No Commentary)
ep04.summary: Morning in the meadow by the first cottage, a lush cave full of flowers and a golden sunset over the water. A second stone-roofed cottage with lanterns goes up, then another wooden house, ending in rain.

ep05.title: Sailing to a Cherry Grove and a Castle Village | Cozy Minecraft Longplay (No Commentary)
ep05.summary: Farm chores at night, then a map in hand and a boat trip along the coast to a pink cherry grove and a stone mountain town. Further on a huge castle-like village appears, then the boat ride home and the explored maps on the wall.

ep06.title: Building a Wooden Bridge Across the Lake | Cozy Minecraft Longplay (No Commentary)
ep06.summary: Night at the base, a huge orange sunset over the lake and a quick cave trip. Then wooden piers are laid across the water in rain and at night, the start of the long covered bridge, which glows with lanterns at the end.

ep07.title: Finishing a Lantern-Lit Bridge Across the Lake | Cozy Minecraft Longplay (No Commentary)
ep07.summary: The covered bridge is finished with hanging lanterns and a planted walkway, seen at night and across a sparkling morning lake. Then wheat harvest and composting, a long lava-lit cave dive and a visit to a plains village.

ep08.title: Building a Big Timber Barn in the Forest | Cozy Minecraft Longplay (No Commentary)
ep08.summary: Clearing the forest by the base and raising a big timber barn: log pillars, round wooden arches and a hay-block path. Lots of night work with zombies, and the barn stands in low golden sun at the end.

ep09.title: Filling the Barn, Then Sailing to a Lonely Tower | Cozy Minecraft Longplay (No Commentary)
ep09.summary: The new barn is filled with cows, sheep and pigs under warm lanterns. Then a long boat voyage past snowy shores to a tall stone tower, a big ocean sunset and a sunken ruined portal on the way home.

ep10.title: Sailing Home at Sunset, Then Mining by Lava | Cozy Minecraft Longplay (No Commentary)
ep10.summary: An evening boat ride over clear water ending in a red sunset at sea. Back at the base it is chests, the barn at night and a long dive into a lava-lit cave for ores.

ep11.title: Fishing at Sunset and Visiting a Plains Village | Cozy Minecraft Longplay (No Commentary)
ep11.summary: Farm chores at the cherry blossom base, compost and wheat, then a stormy night of rain. A calm fishing session on the lake ends in a red sunset, and a walk leads to a plains village seen by day and night.

ep12.title: Mining Day, Red Sunset and a New Village House | Cozy Minecraft Longplay (No Commentary)
ep12.summary: A long mining trip underground with lava and ores, then a beach, a rainstorm and a deep red sunset. Back in the plains village a foundation of dark stone is laid and a new wooden house is framed.

ep13.title: Finishing a Cozy House in a Plains Village | Cozy Minecraft Longplay (No Commentary)
ep13.summary: An iron golem at sunset, then the dark-roof house in the plains village gets its roof, windows and details. It glows warmly at night, and the episode ends back at the cherry base with chickens and sheep.

ep14.title: A Sunset Walk, Deep Mining and Fishing in the Rain | Cozy Minecraft Longplay (No Commentary)
ep14.summary: Riding from the plains village home, then a sunset walk on the lantern path of the cherry village and a very long mining trip. It ends with rain over the covered bridge and calm fishing on the lake from rain to dusk.

ep15.title: A Red Sunset and a Tiny Library in the Cherry Forest | Cozy Minecraft Longplay (No Commentary)
ep15.summary: Rainy farming at the cherry village, a snowy ravine with lava, and a long red sunset beside a stone-roof cottage. An open timber hall at dusk, a village walk, fishing, and a tiny library among the cherry trees to finish.

ep16.title: A Boat Expedition With a Map, Home at Sunset | Cozy Minecraft Longplay (No Commentary)
ep16.summary: A map-guided boat expedition along rivers and coasts to a treasure, mountains and a stone village with a church. A sunset row home over glassy water, then a rainy evening at the cherry base with lanterns and horses.

ep17.title: Branch Mining Deep Underground for Diamonds | Cozy Minecraft Longplay (No Commentary)
ep17.summary: Straight down from the cherry village into the deepslate for a long branch mine: torches, tunnels and veins of diamonds, with cave sounds all the way.

ep18.title: Cozy Shaders, Sunset Boats and a Stone Keep Begins | Cozy Minecraft Longplay (No Commentary)
ep18.summary: First episode with shaders: misty pink mornings in the cherry village, glowing night paths and sunset boat rides on mirror-calm water. Across the lake a stone-brick keep is laid out and its tall walls begin to rise.

ep19.title: Building a Windmill by the Lake, From Tower to Blades | Cozy Minecraft Longplay (No Commentary)
ep19.summary: A windmill is built on the lakeshore: tower and scaffolding at sunset, blade arms raised at night, then the full reveal in golden haze. It is seen from a boat and finally lit up under the stars with fireflies.

ep20.title: Turning a Hill Into a Terraced Farm Under a Windmill | Cozy Minecraft Longplay (No Commentary)
ep20.summary: The hill around the windmill becomes a terraced farm: dirt terraces cut, tilled, watered and lit with lanterns through day, night and rain. It ends with crops sprouting under the windmill in golden haze and a boat back at sunset.

ep21.title: Harvest at the Windmill and a First Trip to the Nether | Cozy Minecraft Longplay (No Commentary)
ep21.summary: A misty sunrise over the windmill farm and a boat glide past its reflection, then the first trip into the Nether among lava and a dark fortress. Back home the terraced crops have grown, with a dusk view of the windmill and a rainy night village.

ep22.title: A Sunset Voyage to a Mossy Seaside Village | Cozy Minecraft Longplay (No Commentary)
ep22.summary: A misty morning, then a long sunset boat voyage with a map to a mossy blue-roofed village and a tall tower in the haze. Back home a second Nether trip through crimson and lava, enchanting, and a full wheat harvest.

ep23.title: Misty Mornings and Night Farming by the Windmill | Cozy Minecraft Longplay (No Commentary)
ep23.summary: Clearing trees in the cherry village and looking out over misty forests in pastel light. Then long farm sessions at dusk and night, with the windmill reflected in the lake and seen by night from a boat.

ep24.title: Building a Big Wooden Stable, From Sunset to Starlight | Cozy Minecraft Longplay (No Commentary)
ep24.summary: The windmill at sunset, a boat back to the cherry village and walks on the lantern-lit covered bridge. A large wooden stable rises in the meadow: outline, sunset frame, walls at night, roof in rain, lit up under the stars at the end.

ep25.title: Finishing the Stable and Bringing the Horses Home | Cozy Minecraft Longplay (No Commentary)
ep25.summary: The wooden stable gets its roof details, stalls and lanterns, and the horses move in, one in diamond armor. Night walks through the cherry village and over the covered bridge, ending with the finished stable in golden hour and sunset.
